I see the issue with my edit. The `wrap % '[^ ]+' + fill + '*'` doesn't make sense because `wrap` is like `(?P<name>%s)` and `%` is string formatting, so `wrap % '[^ ]+'` would give `(?P<name>[^ ]+)`. Then `+ fill + '*'` would append that. But this breaks when `s` already has content from other processing (like numeric prefixes).

- `s` could be `(.+?)` or `(?P<name>.+?)` or `\d+` etc.
- We want to replace `.+?` (or similar) with `[^ ]+` while preserving the group wrapper
